description:
Control devices/services.

Dispatch a declared message with the payload its discovery entry shows ({} if fieldless) to one discovered logical id or endpoint_query-style query. Named devices, including dim/color, require their endpoint; groups require room/group intent. Unqualified vacuum start is whole-device. Queries freeze 1-100 authorized matches; zero/over-limit sends nothing. Copy references/account; Port OS selects routes.

Whole-home lights: one complete confirmed-lighting query; rooms: resolved lighting group. Query adds no exclusions. Include confirmed lamps/plugs; exclude appliances, fans, simulators, catalogs and duplicates. Discover missing scope only; report unresolved coverage.

Commands: waitForResult=false; acknowledge accepted/pending and stop, without auto-poll/read/card. State/settings: endpoint_query with expand and forceDeviceAttributeQuery:true. Replies (snapshots, SDP, searches, queues, scene creation, authorization challenges): wait true. Empty QUEUED/IN_PROGRESS remains pending; acceptance proves no physical state.

Tools-only recipes: media-search/search-media {"query":"<search>","type":"track"}; media-queue/play-queue {"mediaIds":["<returned ID>"]}; get-queue {}; add-to-queue {"mediaId":"<returned ID>"}, plus fresh queueVersion only when requiresQueueVersion=true. Match declared resources/bounds. Queue differs from saved playlist; failed search proves no state. Scenes: group_query expand:["scene"], forceDeviceAttributeQuery:true; scene/activate {"sceneId":"<returned ID>"}; scene/create-scene {"name":"<name>"} captures settings, wait true. Recover uncertain creation before another write. Full workflows: skills or portos://guides/index.

New action: new idempotencyKey; copy caller keys exactly. Never auto-repeat TIMED_OUT/ambiguous failure (including 404): without a receipt, the same key can dispatch anew. Recover authorized receipt/fresh state; authorized retry retains all arguments/key/wait mode. MESSAGE_UNSUPPORTED/MESSAGE_AMBIGUOUS sent nothing: correct from discovery. Inspect partial/errors; unreachable rejected delivery, conflicting observations prove no success. Inventory: management tools.

correlationToken.description: Optional token; PIN mutations default to idempotencyKey for query-operation.

id.description: Returned endpoint/group reference, compact or full, copied from discovery.

idempotencyKey.description: Required nonempty key for every call, including reads/discovery. New action, new key; copy caller keys exactly. Retries attach to existing receipts for 24h; never auto-retry.

message.description: Returned message reference, compact or full; retain @version only when listed.

payload.description: Documented command payload object; {} if fieldless.

allOf.description: Optional field-first filter. Omit it to load full context; filter only when the account is large. Each key is a field or a combinator, and all keys of one object must match: {"name": {"like": "living"}, "type": {"in": ["LIGHT", "SWITCH"]}}. Combinators: {"and": [query, ...]}, {"or": [query, ...]}, {"not": query}. Text operators: eq (exact), in (any of a list), like (case-insensitive substring), lt and gt (lexical order). List operators: has (contains the exact value), like (some value contains the substring, case-insensitive). Fields: id (text) returned endpoint ID; name (text) endpoint name; type (text) effective endpoint type, including customer overrides, such as LIGHT, SWITCH, PLUG or ROBOT_VACUUM; manufacturer (text) manufacturer name; model (text) model name; ownerId (text, eq only at the top level) principal whose endpoints to list; defaults to the caller; interfaces (list) full capability interface namespaces; messages (list) returned message IDs the endpoint accepts; controllableGroups (list) IDs of groups the endpoint can act on, such as rooms a vacuum can clean (needs group:read).

query.description: endpoint_query filter, exclusive with id. Freezes 1-100 authorized matches once.

waitForResult.description: False for ordinary commands; true when requested data or a protocol reply is needed. Acceptance does not prove physical completion.

name: control
